content.json:
# 🛡️ Defender Vulnerability Management Dashboard

Vulnerability posture from **Microsoft Defender XDR Advanced Hunting** (`DeviceTvm*` tables), queried natively — **not** ingested into the Log Analytics workspace.

> **Data source: Advanced Hunting.** Every tile is bound to the **Advanced Hunting** data source against the **CyberSOC** workspace. If you import this into a different workspace, edit any tile → **Advanced Editor** → update the `selectedWorkspaceIds` / `crossComponentResources` to your workspace, or just re-pick it in the **Workspaces** selector.

**Layout (3 zones):** KPIs → Risk & Exposure (incl. ageing) → Prioritised actions → Assets & Software → Secure configuration.

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"let v = DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities;
v | summarize Value = dcount(CveId) | extend Metric = "Total CVEs", Description = "Distinct CVEs across all devices", Sort = 0
| union (v | summarize Value = dcountif(CveId, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel == "Critical") | extend Metric = "Critical", Description = "Distinct Critical-severity CVEs", Sort = 1)
| union (v | summarize Value = dcountif(CveId, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel == "High") | extend Metric = "High", Description = "Distinct High-severity CVEs", Sort = 2)
| union (v | summarize Value = dcountif(CveId, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel == "Medium") | extend Metric = "Medium", Description = "Distinct Medium-severity CVEs", Sort = 3)
| union (v | summarize Value = dcountif(CveId, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel == "Low") | extend Metric = "Low", Description = "Distinct Low-severity CVEs", Sort = 4)
| union (v | summarize Value = dcount(DeviceId) | extend Metric = "Affected devices", Description = "Devices with at least one open vulnerability", Sort = 5)
| order by Sort asc
| project Metric, Value, Description","selectedWorkspaceIds":["e34d562e-ef12-4c4e-9bc0-7c6ae357c015"]}
content.title: Open vulnerabilities by severity
🔥 Actively exploitable (Critical/High)
Sensor coverage (onboarded vs known devices)

content.json:
## 2. Risk exposure overview — Zone 2 (trends & ageing)
Severity mix, CVSS spread, and vulnerability ageing (by CVE disclosure date).

content.query: {"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities\r\n| summarize Devices = dcount(DeviceId), CVEs = dcount(CveId) by VulnerabilitySeverityLevel\r\n| order by CVEs desc","selectedWorkspaceIds":["e34d562e-ef12-4c4e-9bc0-7c6ae357c015"]}
content.title: Vulnerabilities by severity

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilitiesKB
| where isnotempty(CvssScore)
| distinct CveId, CvssScore
| summarize CVEs = count() by CvssBucket = case(
    CvssScore >= 9.0, "9.0-10  Critical",
    CvssScore >= 7.0, "7.0-8.9 High",
    CvssScore >= 4.0, "4.0-6.9 Medium",
    "0-3.9   Low")
| order by CvssBucket desc","selectedWorkspaceIds":["e34d562e-ef12-4c4e-9bc0-7c6ae357c015"]}
content.title: CVSS score distribution

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"let kb = DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilitiesKB | distinct CveId, PublishedDate;
DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| distinct CveId, DeviceId
| join kind=inner kb on CveId
| extend AgeDays = datetime_diff('day', now(), PublishedDate)
| where AgeDays <= 30
| extend OrderKey = iff(AgeDays <= 7, 1, 2)
| extend AgeBucket = iff(AgeDays <= 7, "0-7 days", "8-30 days")
| summarize Exposures = count() by AgeBucket, OrderKey
| order by OrderKey asc
| project AgeBucket, Exposures","selectedWorkspaceIds":["e34d562e-ef12-4c4e-9bc0-7c6ae357c015"]}
content.title: Newly disclosed vulnerabilities (last 30 days, by disclosure date)

content.json:
## 3. Top risks — prioritised action list
Ranked by **exposure × severity × exploitability**. Fix from the top down.

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"let kb = DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilitiesKB | distinct CveId, CvssScore, IsExploitAvailable;
DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| summarize ExposedDevices = dcount(DeviceId), Software = make_set(SoftwareName, 5) by CveId, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel
| join kind=leftouter kb on CveId
| extend Exploit = iff(IsExploitAvailable == 1, "Yes", "No")
| extend Priority = ExposedDevices
    * case(VulnerabilitySeverityLevel == "Critical", 4, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel == "High", 3, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel == "Medium", 2, 1)
    * iff(IsExploitAvailable == 1, 3, 1)
| project CveId, Severity = VulnerabilitySeverityLevel, CvssScore, Exploit, ExposedDevices, Software, Priority
| order by Priority desc
| take {TopN}","selectedWorkspaceIds":["e34d562e-ef12-4c4e-9bc0-7c6ae357c015"]}
content.title: Top vulnerabilities to fix now

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"let kb = DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilitiesKB | where IsExploitAvailable == 1 | distinct CveId, CvssScore;
DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| where CveId in ((kb | project CveId))
| summarize ExposedDevices = dcount(DeviceId) by CveId, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel
| join kind=leftouter kb on CveId
| project CveId, Severity = VulnerabilitySeverityLevel, CvssScore, ExposedDevices
| order by ExposedDevices desc
| take {TopN}","selectedWorkspaceIds":["e34d562e-ef12-4c4e-9bc0-7c6ae357c015"]}
content.title: Known-exploitable vulnerabilities (public exploit available)

content.json:
### 🎯 CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV)
Flagged against the CISA KEV catalogue (v2026.06.24 import; 1,627 CVEs). These are **confirmed exploited in the wild** — fix before non-KEV criticals. Refresh the embedded list periodically.

content.title: CISA KEV — known exploited in the wild (present in your environment)

content.json:
## 4. Asset & software context — Zone 3 (action tables)
Top vulnerable software, the most exposed devices, and unsupported (end-of-life) software.

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| summarize Vulnerabilities = dcount(CveId), Devices = dcount(DeviceId) by SoftwareVendor, SoftwareName
| order by Vulnerabilities desc
| take {TopN}","selectedWorkspaceIds":["e34d562e-ef12-4c4e-9bc0-7c6ae357c015"]}
content.title: Top vulnerable software

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| summarize TotalCVEs = dcount(CveId),
    Critical = dcountif(CveId, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel == "Critical"),
    High = dcountif(CveId, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel == "High")
    by DeviceName, OSPlatform
| order by Critical desc, TotalCVEs desc
| take {TopN}","selectedWorkspaceIds":["e34d562e-ef12-4c4e-9bc0-7c6ae357c015"]}
content.title: Most vulnerable devices (top hosts)

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"DeviceTvmSoftwareInventory
| where EndOfSupportStatus in ("EOS", "Upcoming EOS Version", "Upcoming EOS Software")
| summarize Devices = dcount(DeviceId) by SoftwareVendor, SoftwareName, EndOfSupportStatus
| order by Devices desc
| take {TopN}","selectedWorkspaceIds":["e34d562e-ef12-4c4e-9bc0-7c6ae357c015"]}
content.title: End-of-life / unsupported software (remediation & cost risk)

content.json:
## 5. Secure configuration posture
Misconfiguration compliance by category (from `DeviceTvmSecureConfigurationAssessment`).

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"DeviceTvmSecureConfigurationAssessment
| where IsApplicable == 1
| summarize
    NonCompliantDevices = dcountif(DeviceId, IsCompliant == 0),
    CompliantDevices = dcountif(DeviceId, IsCompliant == 1)
    by ConfigurationCategory
| extend CompliancePct = round(100.0 * CompliantDevices / (CompliantDevices + NonCompliantDevices), 1)
| order by NonCompliantDevices desc","selectedWorkspaceIds":["e34d562e-ef12-4c4e-9bc0-7c6ae357c015"]}
content.title: Secure configuration compliance by category

content.json:
## 6. Exposure Management — attack surface & critical assets
From Microsoft Security Exposure Management (ExposureGraphNodes, baseline assessments). Closes the internet-facing and asset-criticality gaps. **Asset criticality: 3 = Very High … 0 = Low.** Internet-exposed assets span Azure, AWS, GCP and Kubernetes — broader than Defender for Endpoint devices.

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"let n = ExposureGraphNodes | extend Criticality = toint(parse_json(NodeProperties).rawData.criticalityLevel.criticalityLevel);
n | summarize Value = dcount(NodeId) by Criticality
| extend Metric = case(Criticality == 3, "Very High", Criticality == 2, "High", Criticality == 1, "Medium", "Low / Unclassified"),
         Description = case(Criticality == 3, "Business-critical assets", Criticality == 2, "High-value assets", Criticality == 1, "Medium-value assets", "Low or unclassified"),
         Sort = Criticality
| order by Sort desc
| project Metric, Value, Description","selectedWorkspaceIds":["e34d562e-ef12-4c4e-9bc0-7c6ae357c015"]}
content.title: Assets by business criticality

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"ExposureGraphNodes
| where NodeProperties has "exposedToInternet"
| summarize InternetExposed = dcount(NodeId) by AssetType = NodeLabel
| order by InternetExposed desc
| take 15","selectedWorkspaceIds":["e34d562e-ef12-4c4e-9bc0-7c6ae357c015"]}
content.title: Internet-exposed assets by type (attack surface)

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"ExposureGraphNodes
| where NodeProperties has "exposedToInternet"
| extend Criticality = toint(parse_json(NodeProperties).rawData.criticalityLevel.criticalityLevel)
| where Criticality >= 2
| extend AssetCriticality = case(Criticality == 3, "Very High", Criticality == 2, "High", "Medium")
| project AssetName = NodeName, AssetType = NodeLabel, AssetCriticality
| order by AssetCriticality asc, AssetType asc
| take 30","selectedWorkspaceIds":["e34d562e-ef12-4c4e-9bc0-7c6ae357c015"]}
content.title: 🔥 Internet-exposed high-criticality assets (crown jewels)

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"DeviceBaselineComplianceAssessment
| where IsApplicable == 1
| join kind=leftouter (DeviceBaselineComplianceProfiles | distinct ProfileId, ProfileName, BaseBenchmark) on ProfileId
| summarize NonCompliantDevices = dcountif(DeviceId, IsCompliant == 0), CompliantDevices = dcountif(DeviceId, IsCompliant == 1) by Profile = coalesce(ProfileName, "Unknown"), Benchmark = tostring(BaseBenchmark)
| extend CompliancePct = round(100.0 * CompliantDevices / (CompliantDevices + NonCompliantDevices), 1)
| order by NonCompliantDevices desc
| take 15","selectedWorkspaceIds":["e34d562e-ef12-4c4e-9bc0-7c6ae357c015"]}
content.title: Security baseline compliance (CIS / STIG / Microsoft)

content.json:
## 11. Browser extensions & software threats
**Risky browser extensions** (Critical/High permission risk) and **software components with active threats** (components carrying publicly-exploitable CVEs).

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"DeviceTvmBrowserExtensions
| where ExtensionRisk in ("Critical", "High")
| summarize Devices = dcount(DeviceId) by Extension = strcat(ExtensionName, "  [", ExtensionRisk, " / ", BrowserName, "]")
| order by Devices desc
| take 15","selectedWorkspaceIds":["e34d562e-ef12-4c4e-9bc0-7c6ae357c015"]}
content.title: Risky browser extensions (Critical & High) by exposed devices

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"let kb = DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilitiesKB | distinct CveId, IsExploitAvailable;
DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| join kind=leftouter kb on CveId
| summarize Weaknesses = dcount(CveId), Threats = dcountif(CveId, IsExploitAvailable == 1), ExposedDevices = dcount(DeviceId) by Vendor = SoftwareVendor, Software = SoftwareName
| where Threats > 0
| order by Threats desc, Weaknesses desc
| take 15","selectedWorkspaceIds":["e34d562e-ef12-4c4e-9bc0-7c6ae357c015"]}
content.title: Software components with active threats
